note: free-exercise-db names muscle groups, not individual muscles or muscle heads. A mapping row means only that the dataset group covers the listed MuscleAtlas group. It is not evidence that every exercise affects every included muscle equally.

abdominals.why: The rectus_abdominis id represents the mapped abdominal group: rectus abdominis, external and internal obliques, transversus abdominis and pyramidalis.

abductors.why: Hip abductor group; no mapped MuscleAtlas group currently represents the hip abductors.

adductors.why: Hip-adductor group represented by adductor longus, brevis, magnus and minimus, gracilis and pectineus.

biceps.why: Arm group used by the dataset for curls. Hamstring exercises use the separate hamstrings group.

calves.why: Calf group represented by gastrocnemius and soleus. The dataset does not distinguish between them.

chest.why: Chest group; pectoralis major is the mapped chest muscle.

forearms.why: Forearm group covering the mapped wrist and finger flexors, extensors, pronators, supinator and brachioradialis.

glutes.why: Gluteal group; gluteus maximus is the currently mapped gluteal muscle.

hamstrings.why: Hamstring group represented by biceps femoris, semitendinosus and semimembranosus. The dataset does not distinguish between them.

lats.why: Common short name for latissimus dorsi.

lower back.why: Region name; no mapped MuscleAtlas group currently represents the lower back.

middle back.why: Region name that could cover multiple muscles, so it is left unmapped rather than guessed.

neck.why: Region name; no mapped MuscleAtlas group currently represents the neck.

quadriceps.why: Quadriceps group represented by rectus femoris and the three vastus muscles.

shoulders.why: Shoulder group; deltoid is the currently mapped shoulder muscle.

triceps.why: Common short name for triceps brachii.
